call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: After-Hours Sell-Off (-18.1%) on $1.00 Non-GAAP EPS Miss & 18.5% Q4 cRPO Guide
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Bill and Gina, Q3 subscription revenue beat at $3,988M and full-year FCF margin rose to 36%, yet shares are down 18% after-hours to $122.95 on the two-cent Non-GAAP EPS miss ($1.00 vs $1.02) and Q4 cRPO growth guided to 18.5% c/c versus 21.0% in Q3. Are you seeing any macro elongation in enterprise deal cycles?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: Chairman & CEO Bill McDermott stated unequivocally that enterprise pipeline conversion is the strongest in ServiceNow's history, highlighted by 19 deals over $5M in net new ACV (+135% YoY). President & CFO Gina Mastantuono noted that the 18.5% Q4 cRPO growth guide reflects an exceptionally large renewal cohort calendar comparison rather than demand softening, while Non-GAAP EPS of $1.00 reflected M&A integration and tax timing despite 32.5% Non-GAAP operating margins.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: AI ACV Target Raised to $1.70B & Autonomous Agent Consumption Economics
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Gina, raising the year-end AI ACV target to $1.70 billion—up 70% from your initial $1.0B target—stands out across enterprise software. How is monetization shifting between Pro Plus seat upgrades and metered autonomous agentic consumption?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: Gina Mastantuono explained that customer deployments have transitioned rapidly from assistant seat add-ons to production autonomous workflows, with agentic action consumption expanding more than 13x year-over-year. Through Action Fabric and AI Passport, ServiceNow meters and governs cross-enterprise agent execution, capturing recurring platform value beyond seat headcount.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Control Tower Alliance with OpenAI & NVIDIA OpenShell Governance
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Bill, could you elaborate on the Control Tower Alliance announced alongside Q3 results with OpenAI, NVIDIA, and AWS? How does ServiceNow defend its orchestration pricing power rather than being bypassed by frontier foundation models?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: Bill McDermott emphasized that foundation models provide raw reasoning intelligence, whereas regulated enterprises cannot deploy autonomous agents without deterministic permissions, CMDB context, audit trails, and kill switches. ServiceNow's Super Intelligence Control Tower connects model reasoning to governed enterprise execution across IT, CRM, HR, and security.
